हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/YduKRh
show.description: While fleeing from goons trying to kill her, billionaire businesswoman Meera is forced to hand over her infant son to a poor farmer to save his life. The child grows up as Vikram, raised with love, dignity, and hardship. Years later, fate brings Meera back to the village, only to mistake another boy for her lost son. As greed, lies, and power clash, the real son must fight not just for his identity, but for the values his poor father gave him.
